label: Privation on capable subjects from the two POTENCY_1 analyses
meaning: At any capable subject and respect, T turns privation into potency and F turns potency into lack of act. Conversely, F turns capacity and lack of act into potency and T recovers privation. No constraint on incapable subjects follows. The calculation requires independent entry into the premises when offered as support.

strong_version_needed.c85e8ef5-3dc4-502d-90f8-da1429e33fd8: The proof uses both directions of the biconditional: .mp (InPotency → ¬ InAct) and .mpr (CanBe ∧ ¬ InAct → InPotency). None of the weak versions supplies the converse .mpr: NoActAndPotencyInSameRespect (f6003a4c) and NotActAndPotencyInSameRespectReading (c6d6379b) only exclude act and potency together, and AnalysisOnMoved (d93acdf0) only analyses potency of moved things.
